description: For altrichq/altric, altrichq/homepage, and any Node service added later -- Calendar included. A new repo should need a renovate.json of about five lines: extend this, name its base branch, done.
Base branches are NOT set here. Every repo has a different development branch and getting that wrong points dependency PRs at a branch that deploys.

packageRules.description: Type packages follow their runtime package rather than arriving separately. A @types bump on its own is noise; alongside the library it describes it is context.
Tailwind and PostCSS move the rendered output of every page without touching a line of markup, so a patch is still worth a look on its own.
